verdict.rationale: Paperspace's docs show users choose a region when creating a machine, and machines run in multiple Paperspace datacenter regions. That gives some control over where machine-attached persistent storage lives, but there is no explicit data-residency commitment and no region choice documented for other data stores. missing for 10: list of available regions/geographies, explicit data-residency guarantees or compliance statements, region selection for notebooks/shared drives/datasets, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: When you create a new machine, you choose your machine type, operating system or custom template, disk size, region, authentication, starting state
Paperspace's CPU machines are available in all Paperspace datacenter regions.
Machines are Linux and Windows virtual machines with persistent storage
